contenders.handicapper_notes: Boasts premier midweek class credentials and proven Sandown Lakeside effectiveness (5 starts, 2 wins). Drops back to a track where his tactical speed can control the race around the tighter bends. Showed great stamina when 2nd to Ferago last start at Casterton carrying 159lbs and carries 153lbs here, giving him a favorable weight leverage.

Dominant last-start winner of the Coleraine Bm115 Hurdle by 0.8 lengths. Outstanding wet-track record (12 starts, 3 wins, 4 places on Heavy) makes him exceptionally dangerous on this Heavy 8 surface. Effective weight of 155lbs is manageable given his progressive jumps form.

Lightly raced 5yo jumper who captured a Warrnambool Maiden Hurdle two starts back before running 2nd behind Ferago on heavy ground. Fresh off a 35-day let-up and handles rain-affected conditions well (2 starts, 1 win, 1 second on Heavy).

Ciaron Maher-trained gelding who consistently sets the early pace over hurdles. Recorded consecutive runner-up finishes at Warrnambool and Casterton. Likely to roll forward and establish the tempo, though the Heavy 8 stamina tax at 153lbs may test him late.

Honest jumper who has placed in three straight hurdle maiden events on rain-affected tracks. Enters off a third-place finish at Coleraine carrying 153lbs and maps to sit handy from barrier 2, but needs to elevate to defeat the top choices.
Beaten 12.5 lengths at Coleraine last start and has struggled for form on flat and over hurdles. Draws the inside rail, which on a downgraded Heavy track can be a distinct disadvantage.
